# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Identify specific deficiencies and violations in detail.
3. Include photos, videos, or sketches if possible.
4. Date and timestamp each observation.
5. Record the name and credentials of the inspector(s).
6. Notes should be precise with referenced codes and regulations.
7. Write clearly and legibly.
8. Document any communication or warnings issued to the building owner or manager about the risks.
9. Mention any previous inspection results and actions taken.
10. Use standardized templates or forms if available.
11. Report any barriers or challenges faced during inspection.
12. Create a summary of findings.
13. Provide a list of recommendations for remedying the issues.
14. Include plans for follow-up inspections or required actions by specific dates.
15. Sign and certify the report as accurate to the best of the inspector’s knowledge.
16. Maintain a copy of the report for your records.
17. Submit the report as per local regulations and protocols.
